name: Should I remove the tub, replace it, or just refinish it?

mainEntity.name: Should I remove the tub, replace it, or just refinish it?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best outcome depends on your goal: if you want a cleaner, easier-to-maintain bathroom, removal can support a replacement tub or a shower conversion. If the existing tub is still functional but looks worn, refinishing may be a lower-cost alternative than full removal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remove and replace if the tub is damaged or outdated; refinish it if the structure is sound and you mainly want a cosmetic refresh.
